titleDv: ޤާނޫނު ނަންބަރު 15/2010 (ދުންފަތް ކޮންޓްރޯލްކުރުމުގެ ޤާނޫނު) އަށް ... ވަނަ އިޞްލާޙު ގެނައުމުގެ ބިލު
summary: This bill amends the Tobacco Control Act (Law No. 15/2010). It rewrites Article 6 so that the rules on who tobacco can be sold to are tied to people born on or after 1 January 2007, with an age of 21 also appearing in the text. It adds a new Article 6-1 and changes Articles 7, 10, 10-2, 10-3 and 14. It also raises or restates the fines in Article 29 and adds new Articles 29-1 to 29-3 on breaches and what follows from them. The scans are hard to read, so some details are uncertain. This summary covers the first 12 of 22 pages.
whyItMatters: If passed as drafted, shops and sellers could face fines for supplying tobacco to young people covered by the new age rule, and the rules would be backed by a longer list of offences.
keyProvisions: Article 1 replaces Article 6(a) and adds new paragraphs (b) and (c). The text refers to people born on or after 1 January 2007 and to an age of 21 years.
Article 2 adds a new Article 6-1 headed with a title about the people covered by the restriction. Its exact wording could not be read reliably.

Article 3 replaces Article 7, which deals with how the restriction is applied by sellers. Articles 4 to 6 change Article 10 and add Articles 10-2 and 10-3, which set out duties and what is allowed or not allowed.
Article 9 changes Article 14(a). Article 10 changes Article 29(a)(1), where fine amounts of 1,000 and 1,000,000 rufiyaa are printed. Article 11 changes Article 29(a)(3).
Article 12 adds new Articles 29-1, 29-2 and 29-3 listing breaches and the consequences for each, including what happens to the tobacco products involved. The detail of each paragraph is uncertain.
whoIsAffected: Tobacco sellers and shop owners, young people born in or after 2007, and the authorities who enforce the Tobacco Control Act.
statedReasons: The explanatory note says the bill amends Article 6 and the related articles of the Tobacco Control Act, but the scan is too faint to give the reasons in more detail.
